manual._note: Human-curated inputs for thesis-critical signals with NO keyless feed. The CHI is now FULLY AUTO-SCORED (CHI-1/3/5, max 3); the only human inputs left are CHI-1's stress-confirm leg (used during a ≥50% drawdown), the unscored institutional watch (CHI-4, shown in Factory watch), and the protocol factory watch. CHI-2 and CHI-6 were retired (CHI-6: on-chain fixed-term ETH credit is <$5M and dormant — nothing faithful to score); the former CHI-5 haircut manual field is auto now. Edit this file (GitHub web UI is fine), commit, and the next build/cron run picks it up. NEVER invent values — leave unset/false until a primary source confirms. See README.md.

chi1_stress.note: Set episode_through_50dd=true only after a ≥50% ETH drawdown completes. Record the ETH-system collateral-share change in pp (negative = share fell) and whether any top venue delisted ETH or cut max LTV >10pp.

chi4_institutional._watch: UNSCORED milestone (does not move the index). Add one object per regulated venue (PB / CCP / margin program) that lists ETH on a collateral eligibility schedule, LIVE. Lights the watch at ≥2 live venues with haircut ≤40%.

kill_criteria._note: Manual legs for the kill-criteria scorecard (src/lib/kill.mjs). Only the criteria with NO keyless feed live here — KC-1/2/3/6 and KC-5's net-issuance level are auto. thesis_clock_start anchors the DEADLINE criteria (KC-1 5y, KC-4 3y, KC-7 2y): set it to when your thesis observation window began. Leave flags null until a primary source confirms; never invent.

kc4_l2_reflow.note: true once a top-tier L2 reaches Stage 2 AND adopts based sequencing; false = explicitly confirmed not-yet; null = unread.

kc5_monetary.note: true if governance repeatedly raises the ETH issuance curve. Net issuance %/yr vs the 2-3% line is auto; this is the credibility leg.

kc7_formal_verification.note: true if AI-assisted formal verification shows material progress within 2 years; false = confirmed no progress; null = unread.
